odc_type: Integer overflow due to improper type selection
observation_summary: A NumberFormatException is thrown when attempting to parse hexadecimal strings that represent values larger than Integer.MAX_VALUE but smaller than or equal to 0xFFFFFFFF.
reasoning_summary: The code in NumberUtils.createNumber() incorrectly assumes that any hexadecimal number with 8 or fewer digits must be an Integer. When a hex string like '0x80000000' is passed, it is treated as an Integer. However, '0x80000000' represents 2147483648, which exceeds the maximum value of a signed 32-bit integer (2147483647). Because Integer.decode() is used, it throws a NumberFormatException when the value is out of the range of a signed integer, even though it fits perfectly within a Long.
